description: This file defines the interface for filesystem monitor logic within a version control system, including functions for reading, writing, and modifying the fsmonitor index extension, as well as refreshing and checking responses related to filesystem monitoring.

methods.name: read_fsmonitor_extension
methods.description: Reads the fsmonitor extension from the index and restores its state if configured.

methods.name: fill_fsmonitor_bitmap
methods.description: Populates the fsmonitor dirty ewah bits based on the index state before splitting during write.

methods.name: write_fsmonitor_extension
methods.description: Persists the fsmonitor valid state into the index extension, using data from the index dirty bitmap.

methods.name: add_fsmonitor
methods.description: Adds the fsmonitor index extension to the index.

methods.name: remove_fsmonitor
methods.description: Removes the fsmonitor index extension from the index.

methods.name: tweak_fsmonitor
methods.description: Adjusts the fsmonitor extension based on the current core.fsmonitor setting.

methods.name: refresh_fsmonitor
methods.description: Runs configured fsmonitor scripts, clears related index bits, and invalidates cache as necessary.

methods.name: fsmonitor_is_trivial_response
methods.description: Determines if the response from fsmonitor is considered trivial.
